brief:
Palestinian children in Gaza have appealed directly to American journalist Tucker Carlson to continue speaking about their experiences, Shehab Wire reported. Speaking from amid the rubble of homes destroyed in the war, the children urged Carlson to serve as a voice for their plight and relay their stories to the international community.

The appeal reflects efforts by Palestinians in Gaza to reach global audiences through prominent international figures as the conflict continues to devastate the enclave.

title: Gaza children appeal to Tucker Carlson to amplify their stories
